# RC54 — Source annotations picker

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `Esc c t` / `code.source-annotations` / `Source Annotations`.
- Added `:todos` / `:todo` / `:source-annotations` / `:annotations` / `:fixme` / `:fixmes`.
- Source Annotations opens a searchable local project-wide picker for `TODO`, `FIXME`, `HACK`, and `NOTE`.
- The scanner uses the immutable project text-file index, recognized source/Markdown files only, first 2,000 indexed files, 1 MiB per file, and 1,000 retained annotation rows.
- Results show `path:line:column`, tag, and trimmed line text; selecting a row opens the target file, moves to the tag, and records jump history.
- Workspace-root identity is validated before and after the scan to avoid stale root/path-associated results.
- Updated README and the iPad QA matrix to cover source annotations.
